repository_state.commit_message:
[SD] feat(phase-b): VM action-bridge so governance writes work on Vercel (D2 prod)

The portal's action route spawned python locally — broken on Vercel serverless.
Add the production transport: Vercel portal -> Node Command-Centre backend (VM)
-> python dispatch.

- core/command-centre/backend/api/intel-governance.js: POST route (mounted
  /api/v1/intel-governance, distinct from the unrelated /governance parser) that
  spawns `python3 -m intelligence.workflow.cli` and returns {status,body}.
  X-Api-Key protected by the existing app.js middleware. Trusts+forwards the role
  the portal injected server-side; never accepts a role from a browser.
- app.js: require + mount the route.
- portal action route: prefer the CC-backend proxy (COMMAND_CENTRE_API_URL +
  X-API-Key), fall back to a local subprocess only when off Vercel (VM/dev). On
  Vercel with the CC backend unreachable, returns a clear 502 telling the operator
  to set COMMAND_CENTRE_API_URL.

Verified live: POST /api/v1/intel-governance -> brief.qa_gate(fake)=404 "no brief"
(full HTTP->Node->python->Supabase chain) and brief.publish as analyst=403 (RBAC
enforced through the bridge). Portal `next build` + `tsc` clean.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
